name: P I Industries Ltd

business.about: PI Industries Ltd is a leading player in the agro-chemicals space having strong presence in both Domestic and Export markets. It has state-of-art facilities in Gujarat having integrated process development teams with in-house engineering capabilities. [1]
business.in_their_words: The global crop protection cycle is at low points, and we are feeling like everyone in the business. What I want to do instead is to tell you what we are doing about it and why we believe PI comes out of this cycle stronger, more differentiated and more valuable. This is exactly what we are doing now. We start with innovative led agri-distribution, moved into CSM three decades ago and now I am proud to say, with our investment in R&D beginning 12 years ago, we are now India's first and only agchem innovator. We see similar potential in the platforms we are building today across the pharma CRDMO, global biologicals and specialty & electronic chemical manufacturing driven by continued innovation, capability development and customer engagement. promise_verdict.verdict: PI delivered the FY26 margin it promised, but the FY27 story has slipped on both lines it guides: revenue is down 9–10% YoY in H1 against 'lower single digit' growth, and gross margin is running ~49% against the 50–52% band it has defended for years. Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 14% is the lowest in 13 quarters, so the H2 recovery now carries the whole year.

bull: Virtually debt-free (debt/equity 0.03): can fund ₹700–800 cr FY27 capex through the downcycle without stress.

bear: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin collapsed to 14% (−15 pts YoY), the lowest in 13 quarters; PAT −70% YoY.
FY27 'lower single digit' growth already off-track: revenue −10% and −9% YoY in H1.
